Subtitle: === General ===

=== General ===
[Updates]
  Camera:
  • Camera Follow releash timer increased from 6 to 12 seconds.
  • Camera Follow maximum panning distance from Hero increased.
  User Interface:
  • Floating text display for Experience on last-hit updated from purple to golden.
  • Holding down Shift or Control will now also register as having the Announcement Modifier held for pinging on elements in the Top Bar.
  Observer:
  • Experience Globes will now be displayed as blue for the team on the left and grey for the team on the right.
  • The top interface has been updated to display Misha's Health.
  • The top interface has been updated to display Olaf, Baleog, and Erik's Health.
  Gameplay:
  • [Undocumented] Abilities that bounce will require all targets to be visible.
  • [Undocumented] Abilities that cleave will reveal the area and not require target to be visible.
  • [Undocumented] Abilities that splash will reveal the area and not require target to be visible.
  Death Recap:
  • Combat Healing will no longer register Mana or Shields restored to allied Heroes as healing.
  Awards:
  • Clutch Healer will now only register healing done to Health.
  • Protector will now register damage prevented by Protected as protection.
